title: Joe Rogan on Why he changed his stance on the Moon landing conspiracy
summary: A clip from Joe Rogan Experience #928 in which Rogan, with Arian Foster, explains why he abandoned his belief in Moon landing conspiracy theories. He describes how doctored training photos fueled doubt before he learned more of the physics.
why: Cited as an example of someone publicly changing their mind on the Moon landing hoax and of why skeptics had rational-seeming doubts.

quote.text: I really liked Joe Rogan's video on this topic
